desc: Implement `count_up_to(x)` via target-sum memoized digit DP for every possible final digit sum.
Correctly preserve the empty product across leading-zero padding and make an actual zero digit force product remainder zero.
Exclude zero itself and return `count_up_to(r) - count_up_to(l - 1)`.
Validate provided samples and small brute-force cases; the digit-DP logic handles up to 9 digits within constraints.
